steps.note: The water is stirred in, keeping the mix at no more than 35–40 % solids and under 65 °C, which would unfold the whey proteins.

steps.name: hydrate
steps.note: The mix is left with little or no stirring, so the powder can take up water and the air can escape.
The milk undergoes heat treatment to kill harmful bacteria like Listeria, Salmonella and E. coli.

processing.text: The handbook describes these steps for recombined milk; reconstituted milk is the same without the added fat.
